messages:
Priya (Finance Ops): FYI vendor NorthBridge Labs (US sole proprietorship) submitted invoice INV-908 for $9,000 but we don't have a W-9 on file. Vendor just emailed asking Redwood to 'gross up' payment because they don't want withholding. What do we do?

Marco (Tax US): Short answer: we cannot gross-up unless contractually obligated. For US payees, if we don't have a valid W-9/TIN we are required to apply backup withholding at 24% per IRS rules.

Sam (Payments): Can confirm our payment rails will apply withholding if flagged. We need W-9 before remitting to avoid backup withholding. If we end up withholding, we'll remit to IRS and provide vendor with notice.

Priya (Finance Ops): Drafting reply to vendor. Want to include timeline and options (send W-9 or accept 24% withholding). Draft below please edit:

```
Hi NorthBridge team,

Thanks for the invoice. We currently do not have a completed IRS Form W-9 for you on file. Under IRS rules, if a payee does not provide a valid TIN on Form W-9 we are required to withhold 24% (backup withholding) from reportable payments.

Please provide a completed Form W-9 (PDF or secure upload) within 7 business days. If we receive a valid W-9 within that window we will process the invoice for full payment. If we do not receive a W-9, we will proceed with backup withholding at 24% and remit the withheld amount to the IRS.

If you believe Redwood is required to gross-up the payment, please point us to the contract clause that requires gross-up; absent that we can't gross-up.

Thanks,
Priya (Finance Ops)
```

Marco (Tax US): LGTM. Add: 'If you think you are not US-person, complete Form W-8BEN instead and provide supporting foreign status docs.'

Sam (Payments): Add note: 'Please upload W-9 via vendor portal to ensure secure handling and faster processing.'

Priya (Finance Ops): Sent. Vendor replied: "Sorry - we're US based. We'll upload W-9 tonight. Thanks for quick response."

Marco (Tax US): Great. Once W-9 received AP can clear payment. If they miss the deadline, Sam please route to withhold 24% and mark as "backup withholding" in the payment batch.

Sam (Payments): Will do. Marking invoice on hold until W-9 appears; if no W-9 by 1778460600 we'll apply withholding.

Priya (Finance Ops): Closing the loop here. I'll attach W-9 to vendor record when it arrives and update the invoice status. :white_check_mark:
